description: P(model has an exact reference CDS) for protein-only runs (Tiberius + Vipsania candidates, protein evidence, no RNA-Seq). HistGradientBoostingClassifier depth 3, trained on the keep-all pools of 15 validation species without ORF-caller gene sets, introns or coverage (clade-agnostic). raw = baseline + sum of leaf values; P = 1 / (1 + exp(-raw)). Node test: x <= thr -> left; NaN -> left if nan_left else right. Thresholds: locus 0.20 (0.30 for clades outside the training clades), isoforms 0.30. The species-out cross-validation optimum, 0.275 / 0.40, lies on a plateau of the F1 curve that is flat from 0.20 to 0.30 on the training species; the lower end trades 4 points of precision for 2 points of sensitivity at equal F1 on the 31 benchmark species (Nov 2026).
